results.snippet: As of April 26, 2026, the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026 season is currently in progress, with teams competing to secure a top-four position to qualify for the playoffs. The standings are determined by a points system where teams earn two points for a win and one point for a tie or no-result match, with net run rate (NRR) serving as the primary tie-breaker for teams level on points. You can track the live progression of the tournament and the specific team rankings by visiting the official [IPL 2026 Points Table](https://www.iplt20.com/points-table/men). According to www.iAsk.Ai - Ask AI: The current standings are subject to change daily as matches are completed throughout the league stage.
